title: Hydrate staff Dashboard from operation-backend

input.requestedOutcome: Integrate the implemented GET /v1/dashboard endpoint into the staff Dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch and cache the authenticated day dashboard response.
Use server operational summary facts in Dashboard KPIs.
Preserve non-covered legacy UI rather than fabricating server facts.
constraints: No database schema or migration change.
Keep classic script ordering and existing inline handlers working.
Do not silently present local values as a current server snapshot.

output.summary: Added a dashboard client and day-view hydration adapter. Server totals and selected-day route plot data replace equivalent local operational facts after the response arrives; other legacy dashboard regions remain explicitly local.

filesChanged.purpose: Use server day summary and route facts; render source-state notice.
Load dashboard adapter in classic script order.
Seed the store-backed test login required by current operation-backend auth.
Record delivered implementation and deliberate series limitation.

details: Response is in-memory cached only and invalidated after writes.

verification.command: node --check allotment_v2/js/04-data-core.js && node --check allotment_v2/js/ops/60-ops-dashboard.js && node --check test/helpers/ops-backend-local.mjs && node --check test/ui/t_ops.mjs && git diff --check
verification.evidence: All syntax and whitespace checks passed.
The fixture auth issue was repaired; suite then fails in pre-existing catalogue/calendar, lock-edit, and booking-form compatibility assertions before its new dashboard section.

decisions: Use only the endpoint's day response for the existing selected operational day.
Do not replace the rolling 30-day client chart with incompatible calendar-month aggregates.
Leave a visible loading/failure source indicator rather than silently falling back.
risks: Full dashboard parity still needs a daily-series API response and server coverage for remaining composite cards.
blockers: Existing t_ops assertions are incompatible with current backend behaviour outside this change.
followUps: Add a daily-series response if the rolling chart is to become authoritative.
Reconcile existing t_ops compatibility failures separately.
rollback: Remove the dashboard script include and adapter; renderDash then uses its established local calculations.
